krateisCube/32503.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: Welcome to Kratei's Cube! Only the strongest win here. Do you feel lucky?

links.text: Cancel registration for Kratei's Cube competition. Teleport to Fantasy Isle.

krateisCube/32503-1.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: Kratei's Cube allows 25 warriors who are level 70 and above to compete for 20 minutes to see who is the strongest. Warriors advance through the rooms of the Cube, encountering hordes of monsters as they go. Defeat as many monsters and other warriors as possible withi…

krateisCube/32503-2.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: A match is already in progress. Would you like to register for the next match?

krateisCube/32503-3.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: What level are you?

krateisCube/32503-4.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: You are registered for the competition. Stay close to me and I will send you to the match manager when it's time for the competition to begin. Don't wander too far away!

krateisCube/32503-5.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: You are already registered.

krateisCube/32503-6.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: Your registration for this match has been canceled.

krateisCube/32503-7.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: Your level doesn't match the range you chose. Please select the correct range.

krateisCube/32503-8.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: Match preparations are under way... Registration for this match has now ended; the match will begin in 3 minutes.

krateisCube/32503-9.htm.text: Kratei's Cube Entrance Manager: You are too encumbered to enter! Perhaps you should discard some items first.
